findings.claim: Lines 20, 41 and 58 now attribute the coverage to "the chapter markers on its YouTube watch page", but the cover ranges (0:00-0:41, 0:41-2:22, 2:22-4:05, 4:05-5:58 on lines 9-12 and 43-46) do not fall on any chapter marker. The live chapters are 0:00 Introduction, 1:00 The ways that can be more complicated than needed, and 2:50 How we can make it a lot simpler. The ranges look caption-derived; I could not confirm them because caption fetches returned HTTP 429, but they are not chapter markers.
findings.recommendation: Either attribute the ranges to the caption track ("Per its captions, with the chapter markers at 1:00 and 2:50 for orientation"), or re-time the covers to the chapter boundaries (0:00-1:00, 1:00-2:50, 2:50-5:58).
